assets.notes: Source archive Datacenter_NVD@10012.zip sha256 4972d1a9726b36279d7c26531b4d0a084156b7d512f5340b6e1063a9cf458fd4; USD master sha256 f8505db78c2d0b3a85e2ee187e09a1bef2f9ee0fb826b9ca59e9db44c26eb1b3. Converted with Blender 5.0.1 OpenUSD importer and glTF exporter, optimised with gltf-transform 4.4.2 (dedup, instance, weld, quantize), normalised to floor contact at y=0 and front facing +Z. Height 3.1663 m includes the rear-door heat exchanger assembly. MDL material library and textures resolve against the pack root and are not carried into the glTF derivative, so the derivative is untextured PBR (0 images).

assets.notes: Operations derivative of nvidia.rack.42u_a_01, built by scripts/asset-ingestion/build_ops_derivative.mjs and independently validated by scripts/asset-ingestion/validate_ops_derivative.mjs (record: docs/remediation/rack_42u_a_ops.approval.json). Static meshes merged by material inside three addressable groups (Rack_Core, Rear_Cooler_Door, Chilled_Water_Risers), reducing 546 draw calls to 6 with an identical triangle count (133,173), identical bounds and the same single material. The source asset contains no separate front-door subtree, so no Front_Door group exists; the earlier 1.0.0-ops build claimed one and mis-grouped the chassis, and is superseded by this build. The validated visual derivative is unchanged. Still untextured PBR (0 images, 1 material).

supersedes.reason: Mis-grouped chassis under the rear-door subtree and declared a Front_Door group that does not exist in the source.

assets.notes: Incomplete USD stage: payload layers are missing. No approved rack source (user CAD/USD, NVIDIA Data Center OpenUSD pack, or licensed vendor CAD) has been acquired, so no real USD-derived rack can be produced. The viewer renders documented procedural geometry labelled "Procedural 3D preview".
assets.blocker: The USD master references payloads/external.usdc and payloads/internal.usdc, and neither file exists. The stage therefore carries no geometry, cannot be validated, and must not be converted to a GLB derivative or marked runtime-ready.
